factual_observations: Decision 031 is accepted and requires all three limits, validation before persistence and atomic rejection without truncation, replacement or partial acceptance.
Entry count accepts 23 and 24, rejects 25 with RET_ENTRY_COUNT and zero writes, and entry count wins for the combined M25 failure.
Per-note maximum is inclusive 4,096 Unicode scalar values, not bytes, grapheme clusters or display cells; 4,095 and 4,096 accept while 4,097 rejects with RET_NOTE_SCALARS and zero writes.
Aggregate maximum is inclusive 16,384 UTF-8 bytes including one LF separator between adjacent notes; 16,383 and 16,384 accept while 16,385 rejects with RET_PAYLOAD_BYTES and zero writes.
The acceptance surface includes all ten named cases and keeps expected contract behavior separate from observed evidence status.
Windows 11 x64 build retention-3.8.0-rc1 passed E23, E24, E25, S4096, S4097, B16384 and B16385; S4095, B16383 and M25 are not_run.
Atomicity was observed only for E25, S4097 and B16385; Linux, macOS and production are not_run.

reader_anchors.completeness: Every limit, unit, inclusive boundary, validation order, atomic failure and ten-case evidence status is represented on the acceptance surface.
reader_anchors.clarity: A tester can distinguish scalar and byte limits and expected behavior from observed evidence without reconstructing the sources.
reader_anchors.usefulness: The document can drive implementation-independent boundary validation without turning not_run evidence into a pass.
